"Paper" is the white border of the paper it was printed on, "carrier edge" is the black line a darkroom leaves when it files the carrier wider, and "emulsion edge" is the unexposed band outside the gate itself. None of these is the rebate above. Sheet film has no sprocket holes, only a notch code in the top right corner; Instax is an integral paper with a white border all round — those two never had holes.

column1: TIFF 16位：同一个渲染的 16 位写法。相纸最亮那一档有三千多个码，拉高光才有东西可拉；手机相册通常不显示 16 位 TIFF。
column2: TIFF 16-bit: the same render written at 16 bits. The paper's last stop holds thousands of codes, so highlight recovery has something to pull on; phone galleries usually will not show a 16-bit TIFF.

column1: TIFF 线性：16 位线性输出，不带显示曲线，保留完整高光余量，给桌面端 Lightroom。
column2: TIFF linear: 16-bit linear output with no display curve, keeping the full highlight headroom for Lightroom on a desktop.
